_description: Conservative Professional — designed for finance, banking, law, compliance, accounting, and healthcare. Pure black and white, Georgia serif font. Research: 61% of hiring managers in CareerBuilder survey dismissed colourful resumes as unprofessional in finance and law. Georgia is preferred over Times New Roman for screen-first reading while retaining the authority of a serif typeface. Based on patterns from Wall Street IB resume conventions and Georgetown/Berkeley Law career services guidance.
_edit_instructions: This template intentionally uses no accent color. Font can be changed to Garamond for a more traditional look. All values are 6-digit hex without the # symbol.
